error_models.preparation_amplitude_damping: One amplitude-damping channel per qubit immediately after the correlated state preparation.
error_models.phase_dephasing: One phase-damping channel per system qubit immediately after the scientific RZ phase layer.
error_models.symmetric_readout: Independent classical 0<->1 readout flip on every qubit after the ideal measurement.

parameters.axis_symmetry_reduction: The amplitude-damping and phase-damping channels are checked for axis symmetry before expanding one explicitly simulated axis. Symmetric readout error is evaluated on every axis because the full measured-output distribution need not share the ideal recovery-event symmetry.

caveat: Localized one-error-at-a-time Aer model study. It is not a calibration to a physical processor, a claim that these channels are exhaustive, or a finite-shot hypothesis test.
